test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 15 March 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The Indus river that originates in the northern slopes of the Kailash range in Tibet, enters Indian territory in which of the following states or union territories?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ladakh.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

__
 
• Indus river originates from the Kailash mountain range.
 
• The Indus river which originates in the northern slopes of the Kailash range in Tibet enters Indian territory in** Ladakh.**
 
• The Indus River originates near the Mansarovar Lake in the Tibetan plateau, on the northern slopes of the Kailash Mountain Range.
 
• Mt. Kailash is the tallest summit of the Kailash range.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Major tributaries of the Indus river are Beas, Chenab, Jhelum, Ravi, and Sutlej.
 
• All the above tributaries meet the Indus river in Pakistan at Mithankot and the meeting place is called Panchnad.
 
• The Indus River, along with the Chenab, Jhelum, Sutlej, Ravi, Beas, and two tributaries from Afghanistan and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, forms Pakistan's Sapta Sindhu (Seven Rivers) delta.
 
• The Indus River empties into the Arabian Sea.
